description: Na₂Ca₃Si₆O₁₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.98 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.84 Å. There are three inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅ square pyramid, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.64 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅ square pyramid, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.57 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded to five O atoms to form CaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra, corners with five SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-72°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.46 Å. There are six inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₅ square pyramid, and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 74°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.65 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₅ square pyramid, and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.65 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-63°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.66 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent CaO₅ square pyramids, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.66 Å. In the fifth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two CaO₆ octahedra and corners with three SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.66 Å. In the sixth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three CaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₅ square pyramid, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-65°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.67 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra that share corners with three OCa₃Si tetrahedra, corners with four ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Ca and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra that share corners with four OCa₃Si tetrahedra, corners with four ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂CaSi trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂CaSi trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Ca and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Ca and one Si atom to form distorted OCa₃Si tetrahedra that share corners with three ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one OCa₃Si tetrahedra. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Ca and one Si atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids that share corners with five OCa₃Si tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₂CaSi trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si tetrahedra, and edges with two ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and two Si atoms.
